name: codeviz
description: Step-through execution visualization for the current file — Python, JS/TS, C/C++, Java, x86-64 asm.

codeviz.command.description: The codeviz command (on PATH after install). Used unless codeviz.scriptPath is set.

codeviz.scriptPath.description: Optional: absolute path to codeviz.py, run with codeviz.pythonPath. Overrides codeviz.command when set.

codeviz.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter used when codeviz.scriptPath is set.

codeviz.autoFollow.description: Re-trace automatically when you switch to another supported file.
